'''2010 Canadian Nationals Jon Lewis DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jon Lewis]] at [[2010 Canadian Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
